values.note: 11 sites for tents, trailers and RVs; the Forest Service recommends trailers no longer than 22 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/cable-mountain-campground ('11 camping units'; 'The recommended trailer length is no longer than 22 feet.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250489 ('11 campsites suitable for tents, trailer, and RVs'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: One hand-pump water source (peak season), 3 vault restrooms (ADA-accessible toilet), fire rings, picnic tables, bear-resistant food storage lockers.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250489 ('One water pump and 3 vault restrooms are on site'; amenities 'Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Drinking Water (peak season)', 'Food Storage Locker', 'Vault Toilets') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/cable-mountain-campground ('ADA-accessible toilet and water available'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The two official pages differ on closing: the Forest Service says 'Open annually, mid-May through hunting season, weather dependent'; recreation.gov says 'accessible late May through mid-November, depending on weather conditions'.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/cable-mountain-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Open annually, mid-May through hunting season, weather dependent.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250489 ('The campground is accessible late May through mid-November, depending on weather conditions.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: First-come, first-served only: arrive to claim a site, then pay at the host or the self-serve fee station (cash or check) or with recreation.gov Scan and Pay where available. Site must be occupied the first night and not left unattended over 24 hours.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250489 ('available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site'; notice 'Camping stay limit is 16 days'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/cable-mountain-campground (Reservations: 'First come-first served.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Extra vehicle $5 a day (recreation.gov: first 2 vehicles free). More than one camping unit (trailer, RV) on a site is charged double occupancy.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10250489 ('The camping fee is $15 per night'; 'Double occupancy will be charged for more than (1) camping unit in the site ... Extra vehicle charge $5 per day (first 2 vehicles are free)') + /rates (2026 First-come, First-served Season $15) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/cable-mountain-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night Additional Vehicle: $5 per night'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Pintler RD), shaded campground on 5 wooded acres of lodgepole along the North Fork of Flint Creek (a section runs through the campground), ~3 mi north of Georgetown Lake off Echo Lake Rd / Red Lion Rd. Red Lion Trailhead a short walk away. --Claude
